description: Source code for a worker that handles resending invitation emails in the Mattermost server, including job processing, email validation, and interaction with the Mattermost API.

classes.name: AppIface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for interacting with Mattermost app, including user retrieval, team membership, and inviting users.

classes.name: ResendInvitationEmailWorker
classes.description: Worker struct responsible for processing resend invitation email jobs, managing job lifecycle, and interacting with the app and store.

methods.name: MakeWorker
methods.description: Factory function to create a new ResendInvitationEmailWorker instance.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the worker, processing jobs until a stop signal is received.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the email invitation feature is enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Signals the worker to stop processing jobs.

methods.name: JobChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel for submitting jobs to the worker.

methods.name: DoJob
methods.description: Executes a job, resending emails if the scheduled time has elapsed.

methods.name: setJobSuccess
methods.description: Marks a job as successfully completed.

methods.name: setJobError
methods.description: Marks a job as failed with an error.

methods.name: cleanEmailData
methods.description: Parses email list data from JSON string.

methods.name: cleanChannelsData
methods.description: Parses channel list data from JSON string.

methods.name: removeAlreadyJoined
methods.description: Filters out emails of users already in the team.

methods.name: GetDurations
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time since job scheduling and the target duration for resend.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Deletes job data and marks the job as successful.

methods.name: ResendEmails
methods.description: Handles the process of resending invitation emails to the list of users.
